items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Tacky Annie started going with Mr. Hoskins who owned the little club, Hugh Hoskins. He had a wife upstairs and a little boy...

ctx.x: Would white people come to Gibson's Standard Theater?

Yeah, you could hardly get in any of those theaters for the white people. Yeah, most of the time it was no place for the colored ones. And especially -- that's another thing about Chicago, you couldn't get in those places for the white people -- in the after hour places, especially. See. No, you could hardly get in them. And Dreamland, of course Dreamland and the Panama and Hoskins -- of course, Hoskins was just about the size of this. Yeah. But the people would come and stand, and take their drinks up off the…
What was the fanciest club in Chicago?
